notes: 24h estimate uses sidecar output_size_bytes for sessions whose manifest created_at is within 24h; it is an observed snapshot, not a capacity guarantee.
Single-source sessions can be promoted by rename without duplicating bytes; the primary estimate therefore counts only multi-source finalizations.
Historical multi-source media has been unlinked, so source A/V streams cannot be independently re-probed; this is itself the auditability gap.

conclusion.primary_risk: 多分段合并完成后立即 unlink 源分段，使合并结果无法与源文件独立复核，也失去失败后的恢复材料。
conclusion.ordering_observation: 当前可见样本中未发现 mtime 与 generation 顺序冲突；这是脆弱性而非本轮已证实的生产错序根因。
conclusion.capacity_observation: 按最近24小时实际完成量估算，多分段源文件额外保留24小时约43.758 GiB，占快照可用空间约8.43%。
conclusion.minimal_fix: 按文件名 generation 决定新格式分段顺序；合并前保存精简 source manifest；只做 ffprobe 元数据校验；合并后保留多分段源文件至少24小时，不做全包转码或并行第二路FFmpeg。
